evals.prompt: Redesign src/FeedScreen.tsx as a touch-friendly card feed for iOS and Android: fix the tap areas, add pull-to-refresh, and make the cards readable on small screens.
evals.expected_output: Generates a responsive mobile layout adhering to touch guidelines.
expectations: Touch targets meet platform minimums (44pt iOS / 48dp Android), using hitSlop or padding for the like button
Pull-to-refresh is implemented on the list (refreshing/onRefresh or RefreshControl)
Cards adapt to device width and safe areas instead of fixed sizes
Typography sizes and color contrast are raised to readable mobile levels (the 9-11px text and #bbb on white are fixed)
